name: Impact metrics band
definition: Full-width band of three or four large outcome numbers with short labels, often counting up when it scrolls into view.
bestUse: Summarising measurable results customers get, between story sections of a page.

demo.how: A few outcome numbers in one band give the page a scannable proof point; each label says what was measured. Play counts the numbers up once, the way a band reacts when it scrolls into view; with reduced motion the final values show immediately. Figures are illustrative.
